coreValues.label: Core Values
coreValues.title:
Returning to the Essence of Faith,
a Journey to encounter God
coreValues.v1_desc: Experience a deep, personal fellowship with our Creator through prayer and the Word. Train to hear and respond to God's voice in your daily life.
coreValues.v2_desc: Standing on the foundation of the Gospel of the Cross, build your assurance of salvation and the fundamentals of belief, one step at a time. Understand the Gospel not just in learning, but also in life.
coreValues.v3_desc: Training doesn't end in the classroom. Within our community, what you learn becomes the way you live — through worship, service, and relationships, the Gospel becomes your life.

hero.title:

value.label: From Our Director
value.title: A Message of Welcome
value.p1: By the faithful guidance of God, it is our sincere joy and gratitude to open the doors of Do Dream Two-gether International.
value.p2: Do Dream Two-gether International is a training program that invites Christian young adults from abroad to receive focused teaching on the essence of faith. Together with the Vine Church community — those who embody the Gospel in their daily lives — participants live alongside them and experience that reality firsthand.
value.p3: Through 'Do Dream Two-gether,' we have sent Korean young adults to the nations for a year, where they learn missional living, leadership, language, and culture. In the same way, this ministry was born from a holy expectation: what wonderful work might God do among the nations if we invited faithful young adults from abroad here, trained them well, and sent them back out?
value.p4: We believe we are called to be restored to the faith of the early church. Though this beginning may seem like a small seed, we trust that as we join in with prayer and devotion, the Lord will cause it to grow and accomplish wonderful things among the nations.
value.p5: We invite faithful young adults from around the world to join this holy journey. May it be a blessed season of dreaming together (Do-Dream) and walking together (Two-gether) in the Lord, building His Kingdom side by side. We bless you in the name of Jesus.

program.title: The Foundation of the Gospel,<br className="md:hidden" /> Experiencing Grace
program.desc: A comprehensive journey designed for young adults seeking true spiritual awakening through the Gospel of the Cross and intimacy with God.
program.f1_desc: Lay a robust foundation in the Gospel of the Cross. Grow through focused Bible training, prayer, and intimate relationship with God and dedicated mentorship.
program.f2_desc: On the journey of your spiritual growth, experience the vibrant culture, food, and history of Korea with new community.
program.f3_desc: Build lifelong partners and friends in faith with young adults from all around the world, sharing faith and vision.

process.title: The Gospel Cycle
process.subtitle: We introduce the three key steps of this journey — gathering, training, and commissioning.
process.s1_desc: Young adults from all over the world, hungry for a God-centered life, gather in Korea.
process.s2_desc: Intensive training in prayer, worship, gospel-centered living, spiritual identity in Christ, and servant leadership.
process.s3_desc: Sending back as spiritual leaders to serve local churches and exert a good influence to both domestic and international communities.

stories.title: Stories of Grace
stories.subtitle: Stories from missionaries who experienced God's grace through the Do Dream Intern Mission program around the world.

items.quote: What a blessing it is to go out to the nations in our youth and spend each day with God. I invite you to join us on that very field.
items.name: Intern Missionary Gaeul Kim

items.quote: I learned to fellowship with God in love each day, to know Jesus more deeply, and to share that love with those around me.
items.name: Intern Missionary Musun Choi

items.quote: To everyone who wants to recognize God as Father in every area of life and desires a place of training — don't miss this opportunity.
items.name: Intern Missionary Jinhdalrae Kim

items.quote: In the end, when God — not myself — becomes the true owner of my life, the one thing I can do is 'mission.'
items.name: Intern Missionary Yeolmae Ha

items.quote: The greatest thing I learned was that 'ministry is not something I do — it is something God does through me.'
items.name: Intern Missionary Bonggil Yun

items.quote: I experienced God's grace covering me in my fear of relationships. I realized that relationships are always an area where I must depend on God anew.
items.name: Intern Missionary Nari Choi
